text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even if nobody ever comes to save us like this...
I think I might actually be fine with that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking on the deserted island, I spotted Mejiro Ryan saying something outrageous.
choice_data_list: (But, this line... have I heard it somewhere before?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Because if we're on this island...
we can be together forever... right?"
choice_data_list: "Even in the outside world, I won't leave you alone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!? Trainer!!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meant at all!!
Wait, you actually know that line from "DoriLove"...?!'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Castaway Romance’.
A shojo manga set on a deserted island where a young lady and her classmate nurture their love for each other."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Mejiro Ryan was saying earlier
was actually a line from the heroine in the play.
choice_data_list: I got hooked too after it got turned into a drama
I got hooked too after it was made into a drama

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "I've been a fan since chapter 1 of the manga... Wait, no! Since the TV drama! What a coincidence, yep."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Look, doesn't this place look just like the setting in that manga?
So, thinking nobody was watching...
I ended up reciting the lines—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~! It was a momentary lapse in judgment...!
Call it curiosity, or maybe just longing...!
choice_data_list: That's a good thing, isn't it? Let's do even more.
Isn't that a good thing? Let's do it more!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Even more...!?
choice_data_list: Come on, while no one's around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Before anyone comes along...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—I-I want to do it.
Recreate scenes from "Dori-Love"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this place...
It looks just like the forest the two of them use as their base...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There were mysterious fruits growing all around there, and the main character was so cute when she tried them for the first time!
choice_data_list: Huh, what kind of scene was that again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Mmm~~~! So yummmmy~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Nobody's watching us,
right...?!"
choice_data_list: It's okay, no one's around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Thank goodness.
Fufu, I really love the scene that comes after this, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Look, the part where the protagonist gets so embarrassed that they run away from the scene—
choice_data_list: Then why don't you try that out too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, well, that part was actually pretty embarrassing...!
choice_data_list: That's your favorite scene, isn't it?
That's your favorite scene, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
!! Y-Yes, exactly...
It's like... my chest is burning up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I want to give it a try.
Please, Trainer!
choice_data_list: That's more like it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...*inhale*
'You saw that just now, didn't you...!
Oh no, my image is ruined—'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "I hate this island!!"
choice_data_list: "Ah, wait!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I've always maintained a cool image!
And now—it's all over!"
choice_data_list: "No, this is just the beginning."
"No, this is just the beginning."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Wh... Don't just make things up."
choice_data_list: "The real you is way cuter."
"The real you is way cuter."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "S-S-S-So c-cute...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"What are you talking about! That's weird, totally weird!
Being cool is obviously way better!"
choice_data_list: "I want to get to know the real you better."
"I want to get to know the real you better."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
""~~~! Ugh, stupid stupid stupid!
Being true to myself is――""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're going to talk big, I'll test you myself!
Let's see how long you can keep running that mouth!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "I'll show you everything, so brace yourself!"
choice_data_list: "Ahaha, I can't wait!"
"Ahaha, I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Urrrgh! *bleeeeh*!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~, I totally blew it, I blew it...!
Reenacting a manga scene... waaah~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
H-How was it?
Did it properly feel like "Dreamy Love"!?
choice_data_list: I can picture the scene from the original!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? T-That much!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I seeee...... Fufu, fufufu.
choice_data_list: Let's do it again when no one's watching

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes!
There are still scenes I want to practice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I should reread it from volume 1 again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Little by little, Mejiro Ryan began to let herself go
on this deserted island.
